summary: Frontend-only DOM/behavior tests for Products grid rework + BackToTop button. All 12 checklist items pass on the deployed preview URL. Verified responsive grid (4/2/1 cols at 1920/800/400), card content data-testids, eBay icon opens NEW tab without card navigation, card click navigates to Product Detail, bulk checkbox toggles selection without navigation, Low/Out-of-Stock tabs render correct grids (both currently show empty state — data has no stock<=3 items which is expected), Archived tab uses same grid with Restore + Purge extra actions, BackToTop hidden initially / visible after >=240px scroll / scrolls back to top on click on BOTH Products and Product Sourcing (Scraper) pages, and empty state renders when search yields zero.
critical_code_review_comments: ProductGrid.jsx and BackToTopButton.jsx are clean, well-scoped, and correctly use data-testid on every interactive/informational element.
BackToTopButton scans window + main + [data-scroll-root] for scrollTop, which is robust for the Emergent scaffold that scrolls <main>.
eBay button uses stopPropagation to avoid firing openProductDetail — validated in test (URL did not change after clicking icon).
Card is keyboard accessible (role=button, tabindex=0, Enter/Space handler) — code review confirms; runtime keyboard test was skipped due to post-navigation ref reuse (not a bug).
seed_data_creation: None. Used existing seeded products (34 in All, 0 in Low/Out-of-Stock, several in Archived).
context_for_next_testing_agent: PRODUCT_NAV testids: prd-all / prd-low-stock / prd-out-of-stock / prd-archived. Grid testids: products-grid (All), stock-grid-warning (Low), stock-grid-danger (Out), archived-grid (Archived). Empty state adds -empty suffix. Card testids include product-card-<id>, product-card-title-<id>, product-card-price-<id>, product-card-stock-<id>, product-card-code-<id>, product-card-ebay-<id>, product-card-check-<id>. BackToTop testid: back-to-top (single instance, appears after >=240px scroll on window or <main>). Product IDs are UUIDs with dashes — when parsing testids, split via known prefix rather than dash-count.
